ask: Implement ONLY the three static methods in codegen/src/main/java/com/jobcrm/codegen/job/Prompts.java: hint(String jobPrompt, String errors), problem(Attempt last), and repair(String template, String jobPrompt, Attempt last). Each javadoc gives the exact strings to build; carry those strings over character for character, including the \n line breaks. Attempt is a record with boolean ok(), boolean clarification(), String body(), String errors(). repair must call problem(last) and use literal String.replace, replacing "{{JOB_PROMPT}}" before "{{PROBLEM}}". Order the jobs so problem comes before repair.
